source: Fifteen exact-ID fixtures from the unchanged R2 purpose research returns, including the operator-authorized longer IDs of 13 October 2026, ported under order P2V1.
notes: All sources are model-authored; unlabelled by a human. The original four cases are unchanged. Eleven longer-ID cases were added by the operator follow-on of 13 October 2026; Qwen purpose-ask-override-001 remains unported by the follow-on operator ruling: it declares a grief hold although holds are set by mention in the sitting, never declared (ADR-0032 (Proposed)); its literal message is not reconstructed around. Existing manifest vocabulary is retained: accepted means labelled, disputed means recorded dissent. Raw source claims outside the existing expectation contract are preserved explicitly as metadata.
